args.title: Fix password reset and other emails linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is used to build links in passwordResetEmail, rollupText, and scheduledExportEmail. In production, PUBLIC_URL appears to be unset (likely since last week's release), so the password reset link and other email links point to localhost instead of the real public URL.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is always set in the production environment configuration, and/or change BASE_URL to read from a required config value (e.g. config.publicUrl) instead of silently falling back to localhost, so a missing environment variable fails loudly rather than producing broken links in emails.
